title: debpalash/OmniVoice-Studio
claim: debpalash/OmniVoice-Studio — Local voice clone, video dubbing, dictation and audiobook maker. The open-source ElevenLabs alternative.
hook: Content creators and indie developers are tired of paying monthly for cloud TTS and sending their voice data to servers; they want professional-grade voice cloning and dubbing that runs entirely on their own hardware.
why_good: OmniVoice Studio is a desktop app for local voice cloning, video dubbing, dictation, and audiobook creation. Its standout capability is zero-shot voice cloning from a 3-second clip across 646 languages, plus a full pipeline for video dubbing (transcribe, translate, re-voice, export MP4) all offline.
value: Freelance video editors and YouTubers pay for a one-time license or donation to get unlimited, private voice cloning and dubbing without recurring cloud fees.
risk: The main risk is that ElevenLabs or other cloud providers could add offline modes or lower prices, making the local alternative less compelling; also, the project's beta instability may drive away non-technical users.

zh.claim: OmniVoice Studio 是开源版的 ElevenLabs 替代品，100% 本地运行，支持实时听写、零样本声音克隆和电影级视频配音，覆盖 646 种语言，无需账户、API 密钥或云端。
zh.hook: 内容创作者和独立开发者厌倦了为云端 TTS 按月付费，并担心声音数据被上传到服务器；他们希望拥有专业级的声音克隆和配音，且完全在自己的硬件上运行。
zh.does: OmniVoice Studio 是一款桌面应用，用于本地声音克隆、视频配音、听写和有声书制作。其突出能力是从 3 秒音频片段进行零样本声音克隆，支持 646 种语言，并具备完整的视频配音流程（转录、翻译、重新配音、导出 MP4），全程离线。
zh.why_use: 与 ElevenLabs 等云服务不同，OmniVoice Studio 将你的声音数据保存在本地，没有使用限制，支持 646 种语言。它还提供了多 TTS 引擎的统一界面，自动检测 GPU，不会静默回退到 CPU，让你拥有控制权和隐私。
zh.gap: 该项目处于活跃测试阶段，可能在不同版本间出现故障；需要技术设置（最新修复需从源码运行），缺乏针对非技术用户的完善一键安装程序，尤其是在 Windows 和 Linux 上。
zh.counter: ElevenLabs 和其他云 TTS 提供商已经以卓越的质量和易用性主导市场；本地开源替代品可能难以在语音质量上匹敌，并可能被视为业余爱好工具而非严肃产品。
zh.differentiator: 将 OmniVoice Studio 打包为 Windows 和 macOS 的一键安装程序，简化界面，面向非技术内容创作者，他们希望获得隐私和无限使用，而无需云成本。
zh.value: 自由视频编辑和 YouTuber 支付一次性许可费或捐赠，以获得无限、私密的声音克隆和配音，无需经常性云费用。
zh.risk: 主要风险是 ElevenLabs 或其他云提供商可能增加离线模式或降低价格，使本地替代品失去吸引力；此外，项目的测试版不稳定性可能吓跑非技术用户。
zh.why_good: OmniVoice Studio 是一款桌面应用，用于本地声音克隆、视频配音、听写和有声书制作。其突出能力是从 3 秒音频片段进行零样本声音克隆，支持 646 种语言，并具备完整的视频配音流程（转录、翻译、重新配音、导出 MP4），全程离线。

pick_reason: Genuinely differentiated local product — 646-language zero-shot cloning and end-to-end offline dubbing over a 14-engine hub, and MCP-drivable.
does: OmniVoice Studio is a desktop app for local voice cloning, video dubbing, dictation, and audiobook creation. Its standout capability is zero-shot voice cloning from a 3-second clip across 646 languages, plus a full pipeline for video dubbing (transcribe, translate, re-voice, export MP4) all offline.
edge: Fully local, end-to-end dubbing on a hub of 14 TTS + 11 ASR engines — pick the best model per language/latency instead of being locked to one; auto-offloads on ≤8 GB VRAM and runs on pure CPU.
why_use: Unlike cloud services like ElevenLabs, OmniVoice Studio keeps your voice data on your machine, has no usage limits, and supports 646 languages. It also offers a unified interface for multiple TTS engines, with GPU auto-detection and no silent CPU fallback, giving you control and privacy.

gap: The tool is powerful but requires technical setup and lacks a polished product for non-technical users.
counter: ElevenLabs and other cloud TTS providers already dominate the market with superior quality and ease of use; a local open-source alternative may struggle to match their voice quality and could be seen as a hobbyist tool rather than a serious product.
differentiator: Package OmniVoice Studio as a turnkey, one-click installer for Windows and macOS with a simplified UI, targeting non-technical content creators who want privacy and unlimited use without cloud costs.
consumer_angle: An easy-to-use app for content creators to dub videos and create audiobooks in their own voice, without cloud dependency.
